invariant.definition: block-constancy: all tile coords within each block equal (exact for invariant sector)

mathematical_object.state_space: R^d (d=1048576), block-constant invariant sector Omega (oracle-exact discovery via SIM2XR pipeline)
mathematical_object.quotient_space: R^r (r=32768), class representatives (oracle quotient from spectral collapse)
mathematical_object.projection: pi(x) = [x[c*tile] for c in 0..r-1]  (first element per block, oracle-exact)
mathematical_object.reconstruction: sigma(q) = [q[c] for c for _ in range(tile)]  (repeat each rep tile times)

parameters.note: silicon closure 2026-09-23 SIM2XR pipeline: oracle-exact trajectory up to 18.66x (err ~7e-13), single-shot discovery-inclusive refuted (0.73-0.83x slower); this PCSS run measures the exact-invariant-sector oracle rewrite WITHOUT charging single-shot discovery cost

quotient.definition: exact block-constant projection with pi(T(x)) = Tbar(pi(x)) on invariant sector (oracle-exact)

reconstruction.definition: sigma(q) tile-replicate each oracle quotient coord back to d-dim full vector
